_⚠️ Potential issue_ | _🟠 Major_

**Ministral “Reasoning” models are included but not ranked, which breaks the new preference order.**

Line 122 treats `Ministral.*Reasoning` as chat-capable, but Line 105 only ranks `Ministral.*Instruct`. That leaves Reasoning variants at rank `0`, so older families can win unexpectedly.

<details>
<summary>Suggested fix</summary>

```diff
-		if ( /Ministral.*Instruct/i.test( id ) )       return 8;
+		if ( /Ministral.*(?:Instruct|Reasoning)/i.test( id ) ) return 8;
```
</details>




Also applies to: 121-123

<details>
<summary>🤖 Prompt for AI Agents</summary>

```
Verify each finding against the current code and only fix it if needed.

In `@src/worker.jsx` at line 105, The ranking regex only matches
"Ministral.*Instruct" so "Ministral.*Reasoning" models fall through to rank 0;
update the checks that use the id variable (the /Ministral.*Instruct/i test(id)
and the related check around the chat-capable handling) to include Reasoning as
well (e.g. match /Ministral.*(Instruct|Reasoning)/i) so Reasoning variants
receive the same rank (8) and are treated as chat-capable like the existing
Instruct branch; apply this change to both occurrences mentioned (the ranking
return and the chat-capable branch).
```

</details>
